item.title: Show HN: VolumeM8 – Volume Control for Chrome
item.summary: Hear every word with clear voices, balanced loudness and safe per-tab volume control. VolumeM8 lets users control and boost the volume of individual Chrome tabs from 0% to 600%. It includes Voice Boost, Bass Boost, keyboard shortcuts, per-website preferences and safe audio limiting. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49278642 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
